title: 第3章 掌门让老奴来助你修行第4章 掌门这不过是一点小小的补偿罢了
content_zh:
“强是强了点，但...本宫岂会让肮脏的狗男人玷污我这具纯洁高尚的身体？！”
柳紫嫣美眸阴沉。
阴阳邪魔功确实是一卷堪称顶级的邪修功法，但其弊端也很明显。
若无阳气辅助，阴阳调和，那它就只能算作是比较一般的功法。
甚至还会对自己产生副作用。
就像现在的柳紫嫣这样。
起初，柳紫嫣以为，凭借自己那堪称妖孽般的天赋和悟性，可以对阴阳邪魔功进行改良。
摆脱对阳气的依赖。
事实证明，她还是低估了这卷阴阳邪魔功了。
或者说，她高估了自己。
这也就导致了，她现在想要推倒重来，改换修行其他功法，成本已经高到她无法接受的地步了。
也因此，此时的柳紫嫣陷入了一个进退两难的境地。
“作恶多端的女魔头，没想到你也有今天！”
瞥视着那在浴池中痛苦挣扎的柳紫嫣，林陌心中幸灾乐祸道。
看了这么久，林陌也已经逐渐不再满足于视觉上的享受了。
若是能狠狠地羞辱一番柳紫嫣这女魔头，那该有多爽？
光是脑补着这一幕，林陌就有点心痒难耐了。
“咕噜~”
“何方宵小？！
给本宫滚出来！”

就在林陌口干舌燥地咽了一口唾沫之时，浴池里的柳紫嫣忽然警觉了起来。
她玉手一挥，浴池的大门当即被打开。
身穿粗布麻衣，身形如干柴般消瘦的林陌，就这样倒映在柳紫嫣的美眸之中。
和柳紫嫣四目对视，林陌心肺骤停，一时间不知所措，就这样怔怔地愣在了原地。
他的脑海中唯有一个念头闪过：完了，我命休矣！
“是你这贱种？！”
见门外偷窥之人竟是林陌，柳紫嫣又羞又怒，连忙招来一块浴巾，遮住了自己的上半身。
那再次看向林陌的眼中，已是浮上了一抹冰冷的肃杀之意。
“本宫的身体，岂是你这种卑贱的狗奴才可以窥视的？本宫定要挑断你的全身经脉，剥去你那肮脏的臭皮囊，挖去你的双眼，将你钉在柱上，在无尽的痛苦折磨中死去！”
柳紫嫣银牙紧咬，嗔怒道。
她眼中的滔天怒火，几乎快要凝聚成实质。
柳紫嫣本来就视天下所有男修如蛆虫，岂能容忍男人玷污她的清白？
更别说此人还是在她眼中，连狗都不如的贱种林陌。
柳紫嫣愤怒的言语，也是让林陌回过了神。
也许是因为过去百年来的心理阴影的原因，柳紫嫣的死亡威胁刚发出时，林陌还真背脊一凉，如坠冰窟！
但转念一想，老子特么都没几天可活了，还怕你的威胁？
“掌门，老夫本就没多少时日了，你真觉得我还会怕吗？”
浑浑噩噩地活了一百一十多年，此刻的林陌选择了当一回真正的男人。
他直视着柳紫嫣那双冰冷，又美得不可方物的美眸，浑然不惧，又格外僭越地道：“你这具美妙的胴体，躲在这里自娱自乐有点暴殄天物了。”
“掌门，不如让老奴来助你修行，如何？”
content_en:
"Strong is a bit strong, but... How can I let a dirty dog man taint my pure and noble body?!"
Liu Ziyan's beautiful eyes were gloomy.
The Yin Yang Evil Demon Kung Fu is indeed a top-notch evil cultivation technique, but its shortcomings are also obvious.
Without the assistance of yang energy and the harmony of yin and yang, it can only be regarded as a relatively ordinary skill.
You may even have side effects on yourself.
Just like Liu Ziyan now.
At first, Liu Ziyan thought that with her demon-like talent and understanding, she could improve the yin and yang evil skills.
Get rid of dependence on yang energy.
Facts have proved that she still underestimated this Yin Yang Demonic Skill.
In other words, she overestimated herself.
This has led to the fact that she now wants to start over and practice other techniques, but the cost has become too high for her to accept.
Because of this, Liu Ziyan was in a dilemma at this time.
"You devil who has done so many evil things, I didn't expect you to be here today!"
Glancing at Liu Ziyan who was struggling painfully in the bath, Lin Mo gloated in his heart.
After watching it for so long, Lin Mo was no longer satisfied with the visual enjoyment.
How cool would it be if I could severely humiliate Liu Ziyan, a female devil?
Just thinking about this scene in his mind made Lin Mo feel a little itchy.
"Gulu~"
"He Fang Xiaoxiao?!
Get out of here! "
Just when Lin Mo swallowed dryly, Liu Ziyan in the bath suddenly became alert.
With a wave of her hand, the door of the bathhouse was opened immediately.
Lin Mo, who was wearing coarse linen clothes and as thin as dry wood, was reflected in Liu Ziyan's beautiful eyes.
Lin Mo's eyes met with Liu Ziyan's, and Lin Mo's heart and lungs stopped. He was at a loss for a moment, and just stood there in a daze.
Only one thought flashed through his mind: It's over, my life is over!
"Is it you bitch?!"
Seeing that the person peeping outside the door was actually Lin Mo, Liu Ziyan was ashamed and angry, so she quickly summoned a bath towel to cover her upper body.
When he looked at Lin Mo again, there was already a hint of cold solemnity in his eyes.
"How can a humble dog slave like you peep into my body? I will cut off all the meridians in your body, peel off your dirty skin, gouge out your eyes, nail you to a pillar, and die in endless pain and torture!"
Liu Ziyan gritted her silver teeth and said angrily.
The overwhelming anger in her eyes was almost condensing into substance.
Liu Ziyan originally regarded all male cultivators in the world as maggots, how could she tolerate a man tarnishing her innocence?
Not to mention that in her eyes, this person was Lin Mo, a bastard who was worse than a dog.
Liu Ziyan's angry words also brought Lin Mo back to his senses.
Perhaps because of the psychological shadow of the past hundred years, when Liu Ziyan's death threat was first issued, Lin Mo actually felt a chill running down his spine, as if he had fallen into an ice cave!
But then I thought about it, I don’t have a few days left to live, why am I still afraid of your threat?
"Master, I don't have much time left. Do you really think I'm still afraid?"
After living in a state of confusion for more than a hundred and ten years, Lin Mo chose to be a real man for once.
He looked directly into Liu Ziyan's cold and incomparably beautiful eyes, completely unafraid and extremely arrogant: "You have such a wonderful body, hiding here to entertain yourself is a bit of a waste."
"Master, how about asking this old slave to help you practice?"
